name: JUnit Failure Notes
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Create a new report after each test run to keep a history. Older reports stay, and the new note gets a number, such as report 2.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. JUnit Failure Notes is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to review your test runs.
